title: Towards a Floer theory for Mars II -- Floer Hessian field almost extends
summary: In part I, \cite{Frauenfelder:2026c}, we showed that collisional periodic orbits of twisted Zeeman systems can be detected variationally by a non-local Hamiltonian action functional. In this part II we show that the linearized gradient flow of this non-local functional is a Fredholm operator and prove a non-local elliptic regularity result. These results are obtained with the theory of almost extendability of weak Hessian fields introduced in \cite{Frauenfelder:2025g}.
